name: s3GeneratePresignedURL
syntax: s3GeneratePresignedURL(bucketNameOrPath [, objectName, expireDate, httpMethod, sseAlgorithm, sseCustomerKey, checksum, type, disposition, encoding, version, zeroByte, responseHeaders, accessKeyId, secretAccessKey, host, timeout])
description: Generates a presigned URL that gives temporary access to an S3 object.

params.name: bucketNameOrPath
params.description: The bucket name, or an `s3://` path to a bucket or object, such as `s3://mybucket/file.txt`.

params.name: objectName
params.description: The object key, when `bucketNameOrPath` is a bucket name.

params.name: httpMethod
params.description: The HTTP method the URL is for, such as `GET` or `PUT`.

params.name: checksum
params.description: The base64-encoded MD5 checksum of the content.

params.name: type
params.description: The MIME type of the content.

params.name: disposition
params.description: The Content-Disposition value, such as `attachment; filename="report.pdf"`.

params.name: version
params.description: The object version ID, when versioning is enabled.

params.name: zeroByte
params.description: When true, the object has zero-byte content.

params.name: responseHeaders
params.description: A struct of custom metadata headers. The `x-amz-meta-` prefix is added when missing.

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: The S3 access key ID. Defaults to the `lucee.s3.accesskeyid` system property or environment variable.

params.name: secretAccessKey
params.description: The S3 secret access key. Defaults to the `lucee.s3.secretaccesskey` system property or environment variable.

params.name: host
params.description: The hostname of an S3-compatible provider, without `https://`. Defaults to Amazon AWS.

rustcfml.notes: Names the first two arguments `bucket` and `object`, and the secret key argument `secretKey`. `expireDate` also accepts a number of minutes and defaults to 15 minutes. Only `expireDate` and `httpMethod` are supported of the URL arguments, so `accessKeyId` is the fifth argument.

examples.title: Generate a presigned GET URL
examples.description: Creates a URL that expires in 60 minutes.

examples.title: Generate a presigned PUT URL
examples.description: The fourth argument selects the HTTP method.
